notes.title: Rune Fencer Illyia Development Update #31 - November 2024
notes.notes:
Hey all,

I've updated my monthly development log for Rune Fencer Illyia, which you can read here on Kickstarter:

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/nootboxgames/rune-fencer-illyia-a-cute-and-dark-metroidvania/posts/4264956]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/nootboxgames/rune-fencer-illyia-a-cute-and-dark-metroidvania/posts/4264956[/url]

I update public updates almost every month, and I'll start posting them here on steam as well, in case folks are interested in seeing how development is going.

There's a big log of public updates to check through- with lots of screenshots and videos of the game!

Occasionally, I also post mini-essays on game design, insights on game development, RFI fanart and more! Enjoy!

-AMO

notes.title: Rune Fencer Illyia's Kickstarter campaign will start on April 25th!
notes.notes:
Hey folks!

This is the first big update on Rune Fencer Illyia's page, and we have some really cool news: we're launching a [b]Kickstarter[/b] campaign on [b]April 25![/b]

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/nootboxgames/rune-fencer-illyia-a-cute-and-dark-metroidvania][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35542870/a768dace4e3c207278182521dceb801bbbf9020f.png[/img][/url]

With this campaign, we're aiming to complete work on the game while keeping the high standard we've retained throughout development. There will be both digital and physical rewards, and a ton of new information about the game that we're really excited to share with you all!

It's coming in less than a week, so definitely hit [b][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/nootboxgames/rune-fencer-illyia-a-cute-and-dark-metroidvania]that 'follow' button here on the launch page[/url][/b] if you want to be the first to support the game when we launch the campaign!

See you all soon!
